label: common_0210_rival_02
text: This here’s a Pokémon Center![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0210_rival_03
text: You can come here to take care of a lot of things\nrelated to your Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0210_rival_04
text: But I’ll leave the explanations to the pros here.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0210_pokecen_01
text: Happy to be of service—and welcome to the\nPokémon Center!

label: common_0210_pokecen_02
text: I’m here to keep everyone’s Pokémon healthy.

label: common_0210_pokecen_03
text: And this to my right is the Technical Machine\nMachine—TM Machine for short!

label: common_0210_pokecen_04
text: It’s your ticket to making TMs, which you can use\nto teach moves to your Pokémon.

label: common_0210_pokecen_05
text: You’ll need to pay in [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]LP[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] and supply the machine\nwith [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]materials[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] that Pokémon drop.

label: common_0210_rival_10
text: LP comes in handy both at these machines and at\nstores! I’ve got a lot—here, have some![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0210_rival_11
text: Oh yeah, and some of these too![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0210_system_01
text: You received lots of Pokémon [VAR 0xFF00(0008)]materials [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]from\nNemona!

label: common_0210_pokecen_06
text: Here on my left is the Poké Mart counter! You\ncan buy things like Poké Balls and Potions.

label: common_0210_shop_01
text: Hello! We accept payment both in cash and in\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]LP[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]—[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]League Points[VAR 0xFF00(0000)], that is. One LP is worth 1!

label: common_0210_pokecen_07
text: And at the Union Circle, you can connect\nwith other Trainers to find yourself some\r\nadventuring companions!

label: common_0210_pokecen_08
text: Come visit us at the Pokémon Center anytime\nyou need any help!

label: common_0210_rival_05
text: We will. Thanks![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0210_rival_06
text:
Remember: “Had a rough adventure?
Get to the Pokémon Center!”\c
Sometimes you have to know this sort of stuff for
quizzes at school.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0210_rival_08
text:
But mnemonics help out! Here’s another one:
“[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]‘R’ you ready?[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] Then [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Let’s Go[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]!”\c
Goofy, sure, but it helps you remember you can
[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]send your lead Pokémon out with the R Button[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0210_rival_09
text: That way, you can have the Pokémon that’s\nwalking with you go pick up items lying around\r\nor go battle on its own or other stuff like that![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: common_0210_rival_07
text:
Now, time to go. Once we leave Los Platos, we’ll
hit the best-known spot in the South Province’s
Area One: the massive hill on the way to school!\c
You’ll usually find Trainers there who are just
itching to battle. Good luck![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
